description: This script handles uploading logs and stress test logs to a server, including TLS connection handling, retries, and cleanup. It is used for managing log uploads in a device environment, with specific functions for TLS connection testing and HTTP-based log uploads.

methods.name: uploadLog
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp to the specified log file.

methods.name: logTLSError
methods.description: Logs TLS error messages based on error code.

methods.name: sendTLSSSRRequest
methods.description: Attempts a TLS connection to the SSR server and logs the result.

methods.name: HttpLogUpload
methods.description: Uploads logs via HTTP/HTTPS, with retries and S3 upload handling.

methods.name: uploadLogOnReboot
methods.description: Handles log packaging and uploading during reboot, with cleanup.
